test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an indirect tax levied in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Goods and Services Tax**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Goods and Services Tax (GST)** is an **indirect tax** implemented in **India** on July 1, 2017.
 
• It is a comprehensive, multi-stage, destination-based tax that is levied on every value addition.
 
• GST replaced multiple indirect taxes like **Central Excise Duty, Service Tax, VAT, and others.**
 
• It is governed by the **Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017**, and is categorized into **Central GST (CGST), State GST (SGST), and Integrated GST (IGST).**
 
• GST ensures a uniform tax structure across the country and eliminates the cascading effect of taxes.
 
• Under GST, consumers pay tax only on the value added to goods or services.
 
• It is implemented under the constitutional framework of **Article 246A** of the Indian Constitution, which grants powers to both the Parliament and State Legislatures to make laws regarding GST.
 
• GST applies to goods and services at different rates: **0%, 5%, 18%, and 40%**, depending on the category.
 
• The introduction of GST has simplified the taxation system, promoted ease of doing business, and enhanced tax compliance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Equalisation Levy**__

 __
 
• The **Equalisation Levy**, also known as the **Google Tax**, was introduced in **India** in **2016** to tax digital transactions.
 
• It aims to address taxation challenges posed by the digital economy, specifically targeting companies like Google, Facebook, and other online platforms.
 
• The levy is not considered a broad-based indirect tax like GST but is a targeted tax primarily applied to **non-resident companies** providing online advertising services.
 
 
 
• **Capital Gain Tax**__
 __
 
• **Capital Gain Tax** is a **direct tax** levied on the profit earned from the sale of a capital asset, such as property, stocks, or bonds.
 
• It is categorized into **short-term capital gains** and **long-term capital gains** based on the holding period of the asset.
 
• This tax is not an indirect tax and is paid directly by the individual or entity earning the profit.
 
 
 
• **Corporate Tax**__
 
 
• **Corporate Tax** is a **direct tax** imposed on the income or profit of corporations and companies.
 
• It is calculated on the net income after expenses and deductions as per the **Income Tax Act, 1961**.
 
• Corporate Tax rates vary based on the type of company, such as domestic or foreign, and its turnover.
